description: List the comments on a Google Doc, each with the text it is on (`quotedText`), the sentence around it (`context`, the text in ⟦⟧), its author (a display name, never an email) and time, whether it is open or resolved, its body and its replies. A comment with a `range` is on that part of the doc, in the body or in a header or footer, and moves with its text; a comment with none was made in Drive and has only its quoted text. Pass a comment’s `id` as replyTo to add_comment, and its `quotedText` as expectQuotedText to resolve_comment.

account.description: Google account email to use. Defaults to GDOCS_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT, or the sole account.

path.description: The doc: a Drive id or URL, or /folder/doc. A tab path names its doc.

name: list_comments
title: List comments on a doc
